question: When was Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award renamed as Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2021**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Khel Ratna Award:-

 
 
• It is the highest sporting honour in India, given by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
• Major Dhyan Chand was a legendary Indian hockey player who won three Olympic gold medals for India in 1928, 1932, and 1936.
 
• On Friday, August 06 2021 the Sports Ministry announced that the Khel Ratna award will be renamed as the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna award.
 
• The announcement came after India's remarkable performance at the **2020 Tokyo Olympics**, where the Indian hockey teams (men's and women's) performed exceptionally well, reigniting interest in the sport.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **"Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award,**" previously known as the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award, is named in honour of the legendary Indian field hockey player, Major Dhyan Chand (1905–79).
 
• **Established in 1991-1992, this prestigious accolade stands as India's highest sports distinction**, presented annually by India's Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports on National Sports Day.
 
• The award recognizes exemplary achievements in sports at an international level, like the Olympics, Asian, Commonwealth, and World Games/Championships, as well as World Cup events and equivalent recognized global tournaments, over the four years leading up to the award year.
 
• **As of 2023, the recipient is honoured with a medallion, a certificate, and a cash reward of ₹25,00,000.**
